Get a unit to slow these guys down or we may have a problem.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 19 (Formerly, [[Headache Headquarters]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Arrow''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Bolt]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every modern [[Bolt]] variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a fast speed and high health, which makes it dangerous. ==Appearance== The '''Arrow''' consists of three blue arrows that move on the path. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively. *As this spawns in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful at clearing it out. *As its quite fast, stalling towers like the [[Frost Blaster]], [[Freezer]] and [[Cryomancer]] can be quite useful. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Spawn |- |[[File:ArrowSpawn.ogg]] |When the '''Arrow''' spawns |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Arrow.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseArrow.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ArrowIconIG.png|'''Arrow''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *When the '''Arrow''' spawns, it uses the sound "bass.wav" which originates from a CD in 1992 called ''Datafile Three''. This was the sound that was used at the start of a wave from 2019 to 2022. *The '''Arrow''' is the arrow that appears at the entrance of the map and goes to the exit, though it is colored blue. *The '''Arrow''' existed in the game before being added to [[Headache Headquarters]], though it would have 9,000,000,000 health, being the highest amount of health in game. It could have only been spawned by an admin. **There also could've been a ''Kill ENEMY!'' [[Quests|Quest]] for the '''Arrow''', despite it not being added yet. *The '''Arrow''' might be a reference to the [[w:c:tower-blitz:Arrow Boss|Arrow Boss]] from ''Tower Blitz''. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' - [[v1.17.2]] **'''Arrow''' added. *'''8 April 2024''' - [[v1.18.0]]b **'''Arrow''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Arrow''' re-added, exclusively to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bug}} Does not move in the [[Index]]. *'''1 April 2025''' - [[v1.58.0|v1.58.1a]] **'''Arrow''' now appears in [[Headache Headquarters]] as part of [[April Fools 2025 Event]]. *'''8 April 2025''' - [[v1.59.0|v1.59.6b]] **'''Arrow''' no longer appears in [[Headache Headquarters]], now only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Now moves in the [[Index]]. {{HeadacheHQ|[[Pro Streamer]]|Wave 17|Arrow|Wave 19|[[Speedy Boss]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
